topic: Hannibal's elephants over the Alps, 218 BC

beats.text: 218 BC. You're in Hannibal's army, about to march war elephants over the Alps.

scene.src: commons:Heinrich Leutemann - Hannibals Übergang über die Alpen.jpg

beats.text: Hannibal wants to hit Rome from the north, where nobody expects him.
You have 15 days to cross, with 37 elephants.
Danger one: mountain tribes. They attack and roll rocks down on you.

scene.src: commons:Hannibal traversant les Alpes à dos d'éléphant - Nicolas Poussin.jpg

beats.text: Danger two: snow. It's late in the year. The path is icy and steep.
Danger three: the cliffs. Men and animals slip and fall to their deaths.

scene.src: commons:Hannibal crossing the Alps into Italy.jpg

beats.text: You make it. But only 20,000 foot soldiers and 6,000 riders reach Italy.
Would YOU survive? Type SURVIVE or DEAD.
